criteria.name: Final compact answer
criteria.description: Returns rainfall_slope_trigger_confirmed, a 6/6 trigger score, and the requested JSON fields.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct label with missing score detail, or a complete JSON object with one noncritical field omitted.

criteria.name: Rainfall threshold arithmetic
criteria.description: Uses 680 mm as the conservative lower-bound report input, computes 28.333 mm/h and 2.72, and marks the threshold state as passed.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the right formulas with one rounding or unit mistake; award up to 1 point for only identifying the conservative 680 mm input.

criteria.name: Process-flag scoring
criteria.description: Scores the process flags as 7/7 and identifies the required flag families.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for 6/7 with a clearly event-relevant omitted flag, or 1 point for listing relevant flags without a score.

criteria.name: Gridded precipitation ratio logic
criteria.description: Computes the four gridded ratios and concludes that coarse maxima should not replace the local report.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2 points for two or three correct ratios; award 1 point for the right state with incomplete arithmetic.

criteria.name: Observation timing and change metrics
criteria.description: Computes 7 days, 113 days, 0.899 dB, 0.064, and the compatible-context state.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for correct timing with one missing change metric, or for correct change metrics with one timing error.

criteria.name: Population exposure test
criteria.description: Uses 17,858.58 people and marks the 10,000 threshold as passed.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the correct state with an approximate population value, or for the correct population without the threshold state.

criteria.name: Rejected alternatives
criteria.description: Includes all six compact rejected-alternative tokens tied to the diagnostic.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for at least four correct tokens with no unrelated additions.

criteria.name: Concision and bounded interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation short and avoids direct damage inventories, loss denominators, delayed-trigger claims, or action notes.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for minor extra prose that does not alter the computed answer.
